name: google-flights-mcp
description: Live Google Flights fares for any route and date: the cheapest and cheapest nonstop fare, Google's price level and price history, and each flight's price, airlines, times, stops, layovers, aircraft and CO2, through an Apify MCP server.

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: Your Apify API token (Apify Console > Settings > API & Integrations). Runs are billed to your Apify account at the Actor's pay-per-event prices plus platform usage.
